hypothesis: Finite exact MC-003 time knots and a single shared time/path/spindle-phase parameter permit a semantics-preserving constructive decomposition. Certified interval/derivative reasoning terminates for separated or transversal events. Exact tangential, multiple-root or singular transcendental events require an additional finite exact decision procedure and must remain proof blockers when that procedure is not established.
decisive_falsification: Any claimed unconditional full route that decides a required trigonometric/analytic equality only by epsilon, finite sampling, subdivision cap, timeout, independent angle coverage or an unproved no-tangency assumption is rejected.

inspected_sources.citation: V. Chonev, J. Ouaknine, J. Worrell, On the Skolem Problem for Continuous Linear Dynamical Systems, arXiv:1506.00695v2 / ICALP 2016

results.finding: The bounded Continuous Skolem problem is reported open unconditionally even for exponential-polynomial trajectories arising from linear ODEs over algebraic data.
The bounded problem is shown decidable subject to Schanuel's conjecture; this conditional theorem is not promoted to an unconditional MC-1 result.
The finite-precision zero-finding procedure terminates under a no-tangential-zero assumption using computable function values and derivative bounds; tangential zeros require separate handling.

reference_route.action: Decode the finite MC-003 exact source while preserving units, exact timestamps, unwrapped spindle phase, setup/body identity, engagement boundaries and immutable source identity.
Split only at exact source time knots, engagement boundaries and setup/context transitions. Each resulting piece has a compact exact parameter interval and a named analytic law.

Retain one shared exact parameter/time variable across tool path, axial feed, spindle rotation and eccentric transform. Never replace correlated motion by the Cartesian product of path progress and independent angular coverage.

For a required analytic sign/equality query, use outward-certified rational enclosures plus a proved derivative/transversality bound. Separation or a simple crossing may be certified only when the enclosures prove it.

If exact symbolic simplification reduces the event without semantic change to the MC-006 algebraic language, dispatch that subproblem to the MC-006 exact route and preserve the producing identity and proof edge.

If zero remains possible and tangency, multiplicity or singularity cannot be excluded or decided by an established finite exact procedure, emit TRANSCENDENTAL_EVENT_BLOCKER. Do not refine forever, jitter, invent an epsilon sign, time out as success or silently drop the operation.

For certified events, apply the existing regularized-removal and durable-body semantics unchanged. Positive-volume material, split bodies and empty material remain programme-owned facts rather than numeric-policy choices.

Propagate unresolved analytic-event blockers to MC-008, MC-022, MC-024 and MC-038 while preserving the full 26-operation denominator. The blocker is research evidence, not an exclusion from the product domain.
